name: debugique
description: Debugique — code analysis app (Express backend + React frontend)

scripts.setup: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.watch: concurrently -k -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix client"
